gateway.name: Banana Sponsor gateway
gateway.hint: Register, then run /banana link <your username> here.

sponsor.name: Banana Sponsor
sponsor.tagline: Click while Claude thinks. Earn LLM tokens.
lines: Every click earns coins; coins buy $1 of LLM tokens.
Coins and bananas are void after 7 days. Lifetime totals stay.

gifts.name: LLM tokens
gifts.description: $1 of LLM API credit, topped up on your gateway account

notes: Shop sells LLM tokens only for now, paid out as a quota top-up on the player's gateway (New API / One API) account. economy: a $10 budget per 7-day window shared pro-rata; coins per $1 = coins everyone earned in the window ÷ 10, floor 500.
